banner.title: Waits for the factory review
banner.reason: A made-to-measure unit's measures are not confirmed yet: the order goes on by itself once the factory review confirms them.

review.WAITING: {garment} measures, revision {revision}: waiting for the review
review.NEED_MORE: {garment} measures, revision {revision}: more was asked from the rider (the next revision is reviewed)

held.right: Your roles do not show measurements: opening the review needs the right to see measurements (body data).

banner.off: Made-to-measure has stopped for {garment}: its rules are off until the Owner starts them again (Products › Sizes & measurements › Measurement templates).
banner.after: The production manager reviews (the right to review measurements); nobody confirms measures they took.

problem.forbidden: Your roles do not allow reading this order’s units.
problem.unavailable: The service is not reachable now: try again in a moment.

fix.MTM_NOT_STARTED: Line {seq} ({rider}): made-to-measure has not started for {garment}, or the style is not made to measure. The rider profile says where it is started.
fix.MTM_OUTSIDE_RANGE: Line {seq} ({rider}): the measures (revision {revision}) are outside the basic model’s certified range: a pattern maker reviews the unit.
fix.MTM_NOT_CONFIRMED: Line {seq} ({rider}): the factory has not confirmed the {garment} measures (revision {revision}) yet: the order will wait for the review.
fix.MTM_NOT_LATEST: Line {seq} ({rider}): made to revision {revision}, but the rider has newer measures (revision {latest}): move the unit to the newest revision.
fix.MTM_OLD_MEASURES: Line {seq} ({rider}): the {garment} measures are older than 12 months: ask the rider for a new measure.

general.MTM_NOT_STARTED: A made-to-measure unit’s style is not made to measure, or made-to-measure has not started for its measurement template.
general.MTM_OUTSIDE_RANGE: A made-to-measure unit is outside the certified range of the basic model: a pattern maker reviews it.
general.MTM_NOT_CONFIRMED: The factory has not confirmed a rider’s measures yet: the order waits for the review.
general.MTM_NOT_LATEST: A made-to-measure unit is made to an older revision: the rider has newer measures.
general.MTM_OLD_MEASURES: A rider’s measures are older than 12 months: ask for a new measure.

remake.title: Remake of a made-to-measure unit
remake.madeTo: Made to revision {revision} of the rider’s measures
remake.remakeToSame: The remake is made to the same revision ({revision})
remake.remakeToNewer: The remake is made to the rider’s newest revision ({revision})

review.NEED_MORE: more was asked from the rider

remake.goods: The returned unit was made to a body: it is scrapped or held in quarantine, never put back into stock.
remake.makeHint: One new order at no price, one unit for each line decided Remake; it waits for the factory review while the measures do.
remake.orderWaits: Remake order {number}: waits for the factory review

held.right: It needs the rights to decide returns, manage orders and see measurements.
held.off: Made-to-measure has stopped for the unit’s measurement template: the Owner starts it again (Products › Sizes & measurements › Measurement templates).
held.decide: Save the decision of line {seq} as Remake first.
held.status: The goods must have arrived (received or inspected) before the remake order.
held.offline: You are offline: make it when the network is back.

remake.notUnit: Line {seq} is not a made-to-measure unit: a remake is for made-to-measure units (replace it instead).

problem.forbidden: Your roles do not allow this.
problem.moved: The return changed meanwhile: it was read again, try again.
problem.unavailable: The service is not reachable now: try again in a moment.
